headline: Backend Engineer | Java, Spring Boot and Microservices
summary: Highly motivated Backend Engineer with 3 years of experience developing and maintaining robust, scalable web applications. Proven ability to deliver high-performance solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka. Passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and collaborating effectively within agile teams.

bullets: Developed and implemented a new microservice architecture using Spring Boot, resulting in a 20% reduction in average response times.
Migrated existing monolithic application to a containerized environment (Docker, Kubernetes), increasing deployment efficiency by 50%.
Utilized Kafka for real-time data streaming, improving data processing capabilities by 30%.
Collaborated with frontend developers to ensure seamless API integration and a smooth user experience.
Developed and maintained backend functionalities for a SaaS platform using Java and Spring Boot.
Implemented RESTful APIs to enable seamless data exchange between frontend and backend systems.
Collaborated with senior developers to design and implement efficient database queries using PostgreSQL.
Troubleshooted and resolved technical issues to ensure application stability and performance.

education.detail: Graduated with honors. Specialized in data mining and predictive modeling.
